title: fpdf2: Exponential SVG '<use>' expansion causes CPU and memory exhaustion in 'FPDF.image()' (CVE-2026-114610)
description: fpdf2 contains a vulnerability where nested SVG <use> references cause exponential growth in memory and CPU usage during image processing. This occurs because fpdf2 deep-copies referenced SVG objects recursively, leading to resource exhaustion. A crafted SVG under 1 KB can cause the process to consume excessive memory and CPU, resulting in a MemoryError and denial of service in PDF generation workflows.
